prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want quick general guidance or specific shop names/addresses and ratings in Pleasanton?

A few quick questions to give the best recommendation:
- What vehicle (make/model/year) and wheel/tire size?
- What kind of tires are you after (all-season, touring, performance, off‑road, winter)?
- Is price your priority, or installation/quality/warranty?
- Do you have a Costco membership or preference for a national chain vs. a local shop?
- Do you need same‑day service, alignment, TPMS/TPMS reprogramming, or run‑flat mounting?

General guidance (to help decide where to buy and who to use)
- Best value/prices: Costco Tire Center (if you have membership) often has very competitive prices and a solid warranty package (free rotations/repairs while you own the tires). They do require appointments.
- Best nationwide installation service: Discount Tire (America’s Tire) is widely regarded for consistent mounting/balancing and customer service; they do same‑day installs often and handle TPMS/run‑flats.
- Good full‑service options: Firestone Complete Auto Care and Pep Boys are convenient if you want installation plus other services. Quality can vary by location.
- Best for specialty/performance/run‑flats: Independent performance tire shops or dedicated wheel/tire shops — they often have better wheel/hub experience and road‑force balancing equipment.
- Local independents: Many independent shops in Pleasanton/Livermore/Dublin have experienced techs and may offer lifetime rotation/balance deals and quicker personal service. Quality depends on the specific shop.

What to look for in an installer (questions to ask when you call or check reviews)
- Are technicians ASE-certified?
- Do they do road‑force balancing and use a modern balancer?
- Do they torque lug nuts to manufacturer spec and recheck torque after a short drive?
- Can they reset/reprogram TPMS sensors (if you have them)?
- Do they handle run‑flat tires or low‑profile wheels without damage?
- What warranties, free rotations, or flat repairs come with purchase/installation?
- Do they offer alignment checks/discounts if alignment is needed?

If you want, I can look up the top 4–6 tire shops and chains in Pleasanton (with addresses, phone numbers, Google/Yelp ratings and notes on who’s best for budget vs. performance vs. warranty). Which option would you like me to pull?
